verdict.rationale: Shared team storage of TOTP secrets with per-member access control is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows personal features: cloud backup tied to a single personal Microsoft account or iCloud, password export, and App Lock. Nothing shows shared vaults, collections, or per-member permissions.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
